ai_analysis.summary: This week highlights an exceptionally active physical profile supported by a strong cardiovascular foundation, but capped by a persistent recovery deficit from chronically short sleep. While your autonomic nervous system remains balanced and your body battery recharges efficiently, a severe mid-week dip in sleep quality reveals an acute vulnerability. To sustain your high training volume, shifting focus toward sleep extension is paramount.

A sharp drop to a sleep score of 45 on May 19 points to a severe mid-week disruption, though you recovered back to the low-70s by the weekend.

actions: **Extend Sleep Duration:** Aim to add 52 minutes to your nightly rest to hit a minimum threshold of 7 hours, which is essential to elevate your 33-minute REM sleep average and support neural recovery.

**Increase Step Consistency:** Leverage your active days to push your daily step average from 8,948 past the 10,000-step mark through dedicated 10-minute post-meal walks.
ai_analysis.coach_take: You have the cardiovascular engine of an elite athlete, but your recovery is currently bottlenecked by your sleep habits. Burning through 529 intensity minutes on just over 6 hours of nightly sleep is unsustainable in the long run. To unlock your true physical potential and prevent injury, treat your sleep window with the same discipline you bring to your workouts.
